text: The major aims to cultivate high-quality dental professionals who master the basic knowledge, theories and skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, have professional knowledge and skills of dentistry, and are capable of diagnosis and treatment of common dental diseases.The main coursesinclude Introduction of Dentistry, Dental Biology, Dental Anatomy and Physiology, Dental Histopathology, Imaging Diagnosis of Dental and Maxillofacial Medicine, Dental and Maxillofacial Surgery, Operative Dentistry and Endodontics, Periodontal Disease, Dental Mucosal Diseases, Pediatric Dentistry, Prosthodontics, Orthodontics, Preventive Dentistry, Dental Materials Science, Geriatric Dentistry, Dental Equipment, etc..The duration of study is six yearsincluding one year of internship. International students will be awarded theBachelor's degree in Medicine
